item.tib: drin chen bla ma rin po che rtogs ldan bzod pa tshul khrims rgyal mtshan la gsol ba 'debs pa
item.coloph: ces pa 'di ni mtshan yongs grags dge rgan bzod pa lags sam/ gnyug ma'i rnal 'byor dam pa tshul khrims rgyal mtshan gyi yon tan rjes su dran nas/ snyoms las pa nam mkha' rgyal mtshan la rtsa ba'i lha grogs rin chen lhun grub kyis bskul te sbyar ba'o//
